title: ShipAngular module manifest
description: Local ownership manifest for an app-owned ShipAngular feature under src/app/modules/<name>/. Generated by `ng generate @sixthsummit/ship-angular:module` and surfaced to coding agents; it is not a source-copy package catalog.

$schema.description: Path to a locally available copy of this JSON Schema when an application chooses to keep one.

name.description: Module identifier in kebab-case. Becomes the directory name and the default route path. Examples: 'auth', 'billing', 'feedback-loop'.

description.description: One-line description used by the application and coding agents.

version.description: Module's own semver. Independent of the framework version.

dependencies.description: Names of other app-owned features this feature depends on. Generation does not install or overwrite them automatically.
